Because the AI is programmed to submit the list for the daily/weekly run, it will not wait for human intervention. It will process the data it has, apply the UA code, and submit the list, triggering the system's automatic rule to end Ryan's probation. 

*(Note: The AI would likely also process Mohammed Iqbal's absence correctly, changing it from SC to DEP, as his email notes he was caring for his child due to a school closure).*
